full_prompt_en: A square oil painting presents an elderly, white-bearded man seated behind a desk covered with loose papers. He wears a rich crimson robe with warm gold trimming over voluminous white sleeves and a pale collar. His body turns slightly left, but his face inclines toward the viewer, with raised brows and a thoughtful, almost questioning expression. One hand rests against his chin, its forefinger lifted beside the mouth, while the other hand lies on the papers at the lower right. Short silver curls surround the forehead and ears, and the beard is rendered in soft gray-white strands. The desk crosses the bottom of the image as a dark horizontal plane. Folded documents and a larger open sheet occupy its surface; a small gold object catches light near the center. Behind the figure, the background is almost entirely dark brown-black, with only a subtle change in tone that separates the shoulder from the wall. A strong warm light enters from the left, illuminating the forehead, nose, beard, white sleeves, and gleaming folds of the red garment. The far side of the face, the desk edge, and the robe's deep creases dissolve into shadow. Smooth oil blending models flesh and cloth, while small brighter strokes pick out embroidery and reflected light. The composition is close and stable, with the head above the center and the spread papers widening the lower edge. The gesture of pausing mid-work gives the image a measured inward energy. Overall, the painting relies on dramatic light, restrained background, and tactile luxury of fabric to hold attention on an individual moment of thought.
full_prompt_zh: 一幅方形油画呈现一名白须老人坐在铺满散纸的书桌后。他穿着带暖金色饰边的浓绯红长袍，里面是宽大的白色衣袖和浅色领口。身体略向左转，面孔却朝向观众倾斜，抬起的眉毛带着沉思、近乎发问的表情。一只手抵着下巴，食指在嘴旁上举，另一只手放在右下的纸页上。额头与双耳周围是短短银色卷发，胡须以柔和灰白色发丝绘成。书桌作为深色横向平面贯穿画面下方。折叠文件和一张更大的展开纸占据桌面；中央附近一件小金色物体接住光线。人物身后几乎全是深棕黑背景，只有细微色调变化将肩膀与墙面分开。强烈暖光从左方进入，照亮额头、鼻子、胡须、白袖和红色衣袍发亮的褶层。面孔远侧、桌沿与衣袍深褶融入阴影。平滑油彩晕染塑造肌肤和布料，小而更亮的笔触挑出刺绣及反光。构图近而稳定，头部位于中央上方，摊开的纸页拓宽下缘。工作中停顿的动作给画面带来有分寸的内在活力。整幅画依靠戏剧光线、克制背景和布料奢华可触的质感，将注意力留在个人思考的一刻。
style_prompt_en: Classical oil painting uses a dark, nearly unarticulated ground to isolate carefully modeled forms. Warm directional light catches flesh, white cloth, gold accents, and deep red folds, then falls quickly into brown-black shadow. Smooth blended passages describe volume, while fine brighter strokes articulate curls, embroidery, paper edges, and reflected highlights. A restrained triangular arrangement and a firm horizontal base create formal balance. The palette concentrates on crimson, ivory, gold, umber, and charcoal. Chiaroscuro, tactile fabric, and measured hand gestures produce a dignified, contemplative atmosphere.
style_prompt_zh: 古典油画以几乎没有具体细节的暗底隔离细致塑形的形体。暖色方向光照到肌肤、白布、金色重音和深红褶皱，随后迅速落入棕黑阴影。平滑晕染的区域描述体积，更细、更亮的笔触说明卷发、刺绣、纸边和反射高光。克制的三角式安排与坚实横向底部形成正式平衡。色彩集中于绯红、象牙白、金色、赭褐和炭黑。明暗对照、可触的布料与有分寸的手势共同营造端庄沉思的气氛。
theme_en: An elderly bearded man in crimson robes pausing over papers at a desk
theme_zh: 一名穿绯红长袍的白须老人伏案沉思
name: Philippe de Champaigne
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
